risk_summary: The outlook acknowledges deteriorating visibility, cautious investment, sluggish demand, and a challenging planning environment across several markets. It provides quantified growth and margin targets, but these rely on broad forward-looking assumptions and exclusions such as the goodwill impairment charge. The extensive non-GAAP discussion may complicate comparability with GAAP results and other companies.
